title: Honeymoon photos labelled Grand Central Station, a Mandela effect
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of Honeymoon photos labelled Grand Central Station, a Mandela effect, about c. 1982-1983 at New York City, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And so, I'm looking at my old photos of Grand Central Station, right? Well, Google it now. It's not called that. It's called Grand Central Terminal.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs appear around him, says that his old honeymoon photos from New York in the early 1980s are labelled Grand Central Station, but that today the place is called Grand Central Terminal. He offers it as an example of the Mandela effect, the idea that many people clearly remember something differently from how the record now shows it, which some take as a sign that reality itself can shift.
